runtime_gates: Authorized driver and runtime injection, assigned GPUs, and native workload execution remain required.
The caller supplies every script policy, threshold, duration, selection, result mount, and permission.
MPI requires runtime-provided SSH authorization and fresh runtime host keys; no SSH keys are baked into the image.
Bandwidth and collective workloads require actual topology and explicit transports.
CPU and NUMA workloads require approved host views, bindings, and scratch permissions.
Storage workloads require the exact approved scratch mount and source; raw-device substitution is not authorized.
Health and burn workloads require authorized current-boot kernel telemetry visibility.
Image publication, deployment approval, and hardware qualification are separate gates.
